notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and its evidence at 622cd82. The evidence was checked on 0.1.78-c1fa197 (13 October) and re-checked on 0.1.78-a116616 (17 October), where CardAdvisory.tsx is unchanged and the card's nudge lost its Close (#271, fixed). Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October); its CardAdvisory source still matches the evidence's contract (inline-compact Nudge with no showClose or onClose, showNudge gating nudgeSlot, the default spoken name). The guide names no other component to use instead, so avoidWhen is empty. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode, and no AppearanceBrand Neutral, which the guide's pages set only to follow Storybook; the second example sets Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative, as the configuration says for a score to act on, and the third is the in-context card after the screen's step is done. Not recorded as gaps, per the pack's rules: the default spoken name's faults (nudge text while the nudge is hidden, a double period, the unclamped value) and the card staying white in every Color Mode.

examples.purpose: A spending score with its reading and one next step, named for screen readers by the score in words.
examples.jsx:
<CardAdvisory
  title="Spending"
  description="You’re within the plan you set for this month."
  value={70}
  nudgeBody="Data confidence is low. Add more accounts for better insights."
  nudgeButtonLabel="Add accounts"
  onPressNudgeButton={() => {}}
  accessibilityLabel="Spending score 70"
/>

from.quote: “Spending”, what 70 means this month, and “Add accounts” as the next step, named “Spending score 70”.

examples.purpose: A score to act on, in red: Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative.
examples.jsx:
<CardAdvisory
  title="Spending"
  description="You’ve used most of this month’s plan."
  value={25}
  nudgeBody="Data confidence is low. Add more accounts for better insights."
  nudgeButtonLabel="Add accounts"
  onPressNudgeButton={() => {}}
  accessibilityLabel="Spending score 25"
  modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}
/>

from.quote: System with negative: red for a score to act on.

examples.purpose: Score only, after the screen's step is done: on the guide's Insights screen, once the accounts are linked, the screen hides the nudge with showNudge and updates the reading.

<CardAdvisory
